title: Input schema of the Upwork/Fiverr Niche Trends Scraper

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Listing/search URLs to start with (Upwork/Fiverr search pages, category pages).

platforms.title: Platforms to tag
platforms.description: Platforms to include/tags for results (e.g., Upwork, Fiverr).

timeframeDays.title: Timeframe (days)
timeframeDays.description: Only count listings posted within this many days for demand calculations.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests per Crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of requests the crawler will make.

normalizeRates.title: Normalize rates to hourly
normalizeRates.description: Attempt to normalize listed prices to an hourly rate when possible.
